title: Insert into a Binary Search Tree
description:
Insert `value` into the binary search tree as a new **leaf**, at the place where a search for it ends, and return the root. `value` isn't already in the tree. (An empty tree becomes a single node.)

### Input
- Line 1: `root`, a binary tree in level order, space-separated, with `null` for a missing child (an empty line is an empty tree).
- Line 2: `value`, an integer.

Lists and trees are written like `[1,2,3]` and `[3,9,20,null,null,15,7]` in the examples. The starter code turns them into `ListNode` / `TreeNode` objects for you.

### Output
The returned tree in level order on one line, `null` for missing children, trailing `null`s dropped.

### Constraints
- `0 <= number of nodes <= 100`
- `-10^4 <= Node.val, value <= 10^4`, all distinct

def build_tree(s):
    t = s.split()
    if not t or t[0] == "null":
        return None
    root = TreeNode(int(t[0]))
    q = [root]
    i = 1
    h = 0
    while h < len(q) and i < len(t):
        node = q[h]
        h += 1

            node.left = TreeNode(int(t[i]))
            q.append(node.left)

  root = TreeNode.new(t[0].to_i)
  q = [root]
  i = 1
  h = 0

    h += 1

      n.left = TreeNode.new(t[i].to_i)
      q << n.left
    end
    i += 1

      q << n.right
    end

  end

  parts = []
  h = 0
  while h < q.size
    n = q[h]
    h += 1
    if n.nil?
      parts << "null"
      next

    parts << n.val.to_s

function line(array $lines, int $i): string {
    return rtrim($lines[$i] ?? "", "\r");

function readWords(string $s): array {
    return preg_split('/\s+/', trim($s), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
}

function buildTree(string $s): ?TreeNode {
    $t = readWords($s);
    if (!$t || $t[0] === "null") return null;
    $root = new TreeNode(intval($t[0]));
    $q = [$root];
    $i = 1;
    for ($h = 0; $h < count($q) && $i < count($t); $h++) {
        $n = $q[$h];
        if ($i < count($t) && $t[$i] !== "null") { $n->left = new TreeNode(intval($t[$i])); $q[] = $n->left; }
        $i++;
        if ($i < count($t) && $t[$i] !== "null") { $n->right = new TreeNode(intval($t[$i])); $q[] = $n->right; }
        $i++;
    }
    return $root;
}

function treeStr(?TreeNode $root): string {
    $q = [$root];
    $parts = [];
    for ($h = 0; $h < count($q); $h++) {
        $n = $q[$h];
        if ($n === null) { $parts[] = "null"; continue; }
        $parts[] = (string)$n->val;
        $q[] = $n->left;
        $q[] = $n->right;
    }
    while ($parts && end($parts) === "null") array_pop($parts);
    return implode(" ", $parts);
}
